credit-note-auto-journal.description: Auto-post journal on Credit Note approval - Dr Revenue / Dr VAT / Cr AR

debit-note-auto-journal.description: Auto-post journal on Debit Note approval - Dr AP / Cr Expense / Cr VAT

payment-auto-allocation.description: Auto-allocate payments to invoices/bills with FIFO ordering

dn-grn-auto-generation.description: Auto-generate DN/GRN with proper sequence on invoice approval, including auto-journal

testing-infrastructure.description: Jest testing setup with unit/integration test patterns, CI/CD pipeline

RBAC Finalization.description: Finalized RBAC logic. Fixed TypeScript errors in product and entity controllers. Synced frontend RolePermission structure with backend constants. Verified production build.

users-management.description: Renamed owner/employees to owner/users, updated roles to: Manager, Co-Owner, Accountant, Data Entry, Normal User, updated predefined permissions for each role type

permission-checks-company-hr.description: Added permission checks to company HR pages - employees page and payroll page now use usePermissions hook to control access based on role permissions

vercel-migration.description: Migrated backend from Render to Vercel: serverless-http wrapper, Vercel Blob storage, vercel.json, Prisma singleton, API URL cleanup

autoSteps: Journal posting on approve (Invoice, Bill, Credit Note, Debit Note)
minimalEntry.flow: Invoice (enter) → Approve → Auto: DN/GRN + Journal + Stock + Status → Payment (create) → Auto: Allocate + Journal + Status

knownIssues.description: Must have fastify.addHook('preHandler', authenticate) - causes 401 errors
knownIssues.fix: Add authenticate hook to all company routes

doubleEntryValidation.enforcement: JournalService and TransactionRepository must validate before approval

idempotency.rule: All auto-journal operations must be idempotent using isJournaled flag
idempotency.enforcement: Check isJournaled before creating journals in handleDocumentApproval

transactionSafety.rule: Multi-step operations must use Prisma transactions
transactionSafety.enforcement: All controller operations that modify multiple tables must wrap in $transaction

nullSafety.rule: Empty strings from client must be converted to null for optional relations
nullSafety.enforcement: Controllers must sanitize inputs before Prisma operations

balanceSignEnforcement.rule: Account balance updates must respect account type (DEBIT vs CREDIT normal balance)
balanceSignEnforcement.enforcement: ASSET/EXPENSE: increase with DEBIT, decrease with CREDIT. LIABILITY/EQUITY/INCOME: opposite

invoice.dates: invoiceDate cannot be in closed period
invoice.lines: At least one line with quantity > 0 and unitPrice >= 0
invoice.status: DRAFT -> PENDING_VERIFICATION -> VERIFIED -> APPROVED (or back to DRAFT)

payment.amounts: amount must be > 0, payment cannot exceed outstanding
payment.allocation: Sum of allocations cannot exceed payment amount
payment.dates: Future dates only allowed for Owner/Admin

journal.accounts: All accountIds must exist and be active
journal.period: Journal date cannot be in closed period

optimisticLocking.description: Use version or updatedAt for concurrent status changes

patterns: Always fetch fresh data inside transactions
Use SELECT FOR UPDATE when modifying same row concurrently

required.delete: Never hard delete - use soft delete (deletedAt)

rbac.pattern: this.requirePermission() at start of every controller method
rbac.audit: Verify all company routes have authenticate hook

dataProtection.validateCompanyAccess: companyId in URL must match user's authorized companies
dataProtection.sqlInjection: Prisma handles parameterization - avoid $queryRaw with string interpolation

inputValidation.required: All request bodies validated with JSON Schema or explicit checks
inputValidation.sanitize: Empty strings converted to null for optional fields
inputValidation.types: Validate numeric fields are numbers, dates are valid

database.indexes: Check all foreign keys and frequently queried fields have indexes
database.N+1: Use include() for related data, avoid individual queries in loops
database.pagination: All list endpoints must support limit/offset or cursor pagination

api.response: Return only necessary fields, use select() in Prisma
api.caching: TanStack Query handles client-side caching, consider Redis for server

currency.multiCurrency: Always calculate both amount (FCY) and amountBase (BDT)
currency.exchangeRate: Rate at document date, never at payment date
currency.rounding: Use Math.round() for BDT to avoid floating point errors

partialOperations.partialPayment: Track outstanding amount, update status to PARTIALLY_PAID
partialOperations.partialDelivery: Track delivered vs invoiced quantities separately

reversals.invoiceRevert: Must delete associated journals and revert stock changes
reversals.paymentRevert: Must reverse allocations and journal entries

recommended.notes: Currently releases on LC closure, could be enhanced with scheduled job

recommended.suggestion: Cron job to check overdue invoices and send notifications

recommended.notes: Has CSV import with basic matching, could enhance with fuzzy matching

recommended.suggestion: Scheduler for generating invoices from recurring templates
Scheduled journal entries for fixed asset depreciation

unitTests.coverage: All validation rules, edge cases, error paths

integrationTests.priority: Full workflow: Invoice -> DN -> Journal -> Payment -> Allocation
integrationTests.tools: Supertest for API, Prisma test instance

monitoring.errorTracking: Log all exceptions with context (userId, companyId, documentId)
monitoring.performance: Track slow queries (>1s), log all journal generation times
monitoring.health: Database connection pool, API response times, memory usage

preDeploy: Verify all controllers have error handling
postDeploy: Test critical flows (create invoice, approve, payment)
deploymentSafety.rollback: git revert + Render dashboard manual rollback

typescript.noImplicitAny: All function parameters must be typed
typescript.nullChecks: Use optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??)
typescript.async: Always use async/await, never mixing with .then()

prisma.selects: Use select() to return only needed fields
prisma.bulk: Use updateMany instead of loops when possible
